params.prompt: First-person point of view from a bend of a hill road at dusk, looking out over a small coastal town: three clear directions are visible at once: on the LEFT, the road climbs further up the green hill toward a small lit window among trees, and far beyond it a rocky headland with a lighthouse; STRAIGHT AHEAD, the wide open sea under the evening sky; on the RIGHT and below, the small harbour with boats and lights. A hand in a navy-blue hoodie sleeve holds a small handmade antenna in the foreground. No text, no signs. Vertical composition.
